title: Development server, Viewer lane, build and cache fixes
why: The Viewer lane picks the right Viewer, the build stops reporting server-only bindings as removed, the dev cache sees atomic replacements and closed HMR sockets are released.
changelog: The opt-in Viewer lane no longer fails
`brain build` no longer reports "Production removed unused bindings"
The development compile cache keys each source
The development server unregisters closed HMR sockets
Production logs recorded a compiler budget failure
